supersedes_execution_spec: v2.0 FROZEN for future/reclassification runs; v2.0 artifacts remain preserved as historical pilot records
semantic_protocol: Emotion Classification Protocol v1.0 FROZEN — unchanged
rationale: Pilot #002–#010 used an execution helper that mechanically set fourteen non-primary/non-secondary scores to zero and showed coarse intensity/confidence resolution. v2.1 restores the already-intended independent 16-score measurement without changing emotion semantics or aesthetic targets.
reproducibility_statement: Ordered inputs, prompt, model identity and outputs are traceable and hashable. Runtime sampling parameters are not fully exposed, so future bit-for-bit regeneration is not claimed; frozen output hashes are canonical records.
